name: Block, Inc.
summary: Primary concern is high volatility, with mixed signals in other areas.

meanings.ret1y: Modest 1-year performance, roughly in line with the market.
meanings.fromHigh: Modest pullback from recent highs, typical consolidation.
meanings.rsi14: Neutral RSI reading, no extreme buying or selling pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Above 2 of 3 averages — mostly bullish structure.
meanings.macd: MACD negative and falling — bearish momentum.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: High beta — tends to amplify market moves by 50% or more.
meanings.mdd1y: Large 1-year drawdown — significant decline from peak.
meanings.sharpe: Modest risk-adjusted return — gains barely exceed volatility.
meanings.pe: Low P/E ratio — trading at a discount, may signal value or concerns.
meanings.peVsSector: Above the sector median — more expensive than typical peers.
meanings.margin: Thin profit margin, limited pricing power.
meanings.roe: Weak return on equity, capital not well deployed.
meanings.de: Minimal debt — very strong financial position.
meanings.liquidity: Highly liquid — ample trading volume and depth.
